content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record ends with the bare FAD statement that Complainant 'failed to prove' discrimination and gives no reasoning connecting the OPR Bluebook Report, the nonselection evidence, or the overheard comment to that conclusion, so the path from evidence to outcome cannot be traced."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Many characterizations are attributed to Complainant, the Division Chief, or the October 30, 2018 OPR Bluebook Report, but the nonselections for Claims 2 and 3 have no identified selecting official or management explanation, and the nine OPR witness denials appear only in summary."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Most events are dated (July 2016 detail, June 2017–June 2018 alleged investigation, April 11 and May 24, 2018 notices, October 30, 2018 OPR report), but Claim 4 is dated only 'June or July 2018,' the initial EEO contact date is never stated even though the Division Chief's June 1, 2018 timing claim depends on it, and the October 2017 resignation and misplaced dismissed-claim text disrupt the sequence."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who issued the FAD or what legal standard was applied, and it does not show whether the travel vouchers, intelligence reports, Administrator's Audit Report, or 15 named witnesses Complainant identified were obtained or considered before finalization."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Given the missing analysis, the absence of any management explanation for the nonselections, and no indication of whether Complainant's identified evidence was pursued, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record alone whether the FAD's conclusion is supported."}}}
